intro:
I'm a senior frontend engineer with nearly 14 years of experience building accessible, high-performance web and mobile apps with React, TypeScript and Next.js. I bring a product mindset, caring as much about what to build as how to build it.

Right now I'm developing core features for the McDonald's Japan delivery platform at The Plant, working remotely from Porto, Portugal. Before that, I spent six years at Baopals leading a front-end team and helping shape the product.

AI is central to how I work. I use Claude Code every day to plan, build and refactor faster, and I'm currently learning AI agent development with the Vercel AI SDK and MCP.

Outside of work I'm a yogi at heart, keeping balanced with yoga and fitness while code keeps me curious.
